en: The image shows a tree-lined avenue with a walking path in the center. The path is bordered by neatly trimmed grass and white-barked trees, possibly birches. There is a bench on the left side of the path, and a single person is walking away from the foreground toward the background, giving the scene a tranquil and picturesque atmosphere. The colors and printed style suggest an early 20th-century hand-colored photo postcard. At the bottom, there are printed words in German.
